existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: Fig. 1D panel label: 'RIMS2' in PNEC row. Fig. 1B panel label: 'ASCL1' open chromatin accessibility peak in PNEC.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: 实地查看 PDF 第 4 页 Fig. 1D 点图：PNEC 对应的主标签确为 RIMS2，Fig. 1B 展示 PNEC 开放峰包含 ASCL1；该图面板中完全未见 CALCA 与 CHGA 标签。LAMC3 对应的主群为 Chondro.（软骨细胞），Pericyte 对应的标签为 NTRK3；FCN1 对应的主群为 Monocytes，Interstitial macrophage 对应的标签为 FOLR2。CA4 对应 Cap1/Cap2 毛细血管内皮。
existing_round1_entry.verdict_impact: 纠正此前 Codex 误记为 CHGB，确认 Fig. 1D 的 PNEC 基因确为 RIMS2；保留 RIMS2 作为待入库候选；确认 LAMC3 与 FCN1 在修补中存在细胞配对错位，原配对须撤销；CALCA/CHGA 撤销原图引文并保持未决。

EVID_01.view_scope: eLife Fig.1B/1D p4 full/detail; PNEC-RIMS2, PNEC-ASCL1, chondrocyte-LAMC3, pericyte-NTRK3, monocyte-FCN1, interstitial macrophage-FOLR2 labels

existing_round1_entry.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: UMAP plots showing transcript expression of AT2 lineage markers, SFTPC, HOPX, SLC34A2, and tip progenitor marker, SOX9, in the organoids. Text affirms AT2-specific HOPX, LAMP3, and ACE2 proteins increased during differentiation.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 3D UMAP demonstrates distinct co-localization of HOPX, SFTPC, and SLC34A2 transcripts within the AT2 differentiated organoid cluster, confirming HOPX as an AT2 lineage marker in human fetal lung development.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Core correction confirming HOPX as AT2 lineage marker, along with LAMP3, SLC34A2, SFTPC, ACE2.

EVID_06.view_scope: STEM Fig.3 caption/text image; SFTPC/HOPX/SLC34A2/SOX9 UMAP marker panel

existing_round1_entry.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: (D) Tip epithelium (arrowheads) is marked by E-cadherin, SFTPC, HTII-280, and SOX9. SOX2, airway epithelium (C). (E) The early-stage tip epithelium at 10 pcw expresses SOX9 and TPPP3, and gains the expression of the alveolar lineage marker, SFTPC, at late stages, 15 and 19 pcw. The SFTPC+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT2 cells) at 15 and 19 pcw lack SOX9 and TPPP3 expression (SOX9-TPPP3-SFTPC+). (F) Arrowheads indicate CD36+PDPN- tips.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S1D-F immunofluorescence clearly distinguishes distal tip epithelium (SOX9+, SFTPC+, CD36+, PDPN-) from proximal airway epithelium (SOX2+) and stalk cells.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates SOX9, TPPP3, SFTPC, CD36 in tip epithelium, SOX2 in airway epithelium, and negative gating of PDPN in tips.

EVID_07.view_scope: STEM Fig.S1 caption/text image; tip epithelium, airway, fetal AT2 and CD36/PDPN gates

existing_round1_entry.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
existing_round1_entry.locator: Figure S5E, S5M, S5N, S5O, S5P & legend (p. 40-41)
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: (E) WNT2, alveolar fibroblasts, white; NOTUM, myofibroblasts, red; CD44, tip epithelium, green. (M) Summary diagram showing the spatial regulation of Wnt signalling mediated by ACTA2+PDGFRa+CD141+ myofibroblasts. (N) Time course analysis of NOTUM+ myofibroblasts, SCGB3A2+ terminal airway cells, and SFTPC+ tip and stalk. (O and P) Time-course visualization (O) and quantitation (P) of SFTPC-/SPOCK2+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT1 cells) and SFTPC+/SPOCK2- stalk cells (fetal AT2 cells)... SPOCK2, red, AT1 cell marker; SFTPC, green, AT2 cell marker; white, NKX2.1, lung epithelial cell marker.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S5 panels show spatial localization of NOTUM+/ACTA2+/PDGFRA+/CD141+ myofibroblasts and WNT2+ alveolar fibroblasts. Stalk regions contain distinct SPOCK2+ (AT1) and SFTPC+ (AT2) subpopulations.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates myofibroblast markers (NOTUM, ACTA2, PDGFRA, THBD), alveolar fibroblast marker (WNT2), AT1 marker (SPOCK2), and terminal airway (SCGB3A2).

EVID_08.view_scope: STEM Fig.S5 caption/text image; WNT2/NOTUM/CD44 and SFTPC/SPOCK2 stalk identities

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: We detected ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, ALOX15+) from 11 pcw, interspersed with secretory/club cells (Figures 2A–2C, S3H, S4A, and S4B). Rarer deuterosomal cells (FOXJ1+, CDC20B+) appeared at the same time. MUC16+ ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, DNAH+, MUC16LO) were also detected... Tip cells express a core set of tip-specific markers (SOX9+, ETV5+, TESC+, TPPP3+, and STC1+).
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 2C dot plot illustrates gene expression across epithelial lineages: FOXJ1 and ALOX15 in ciliated cells; CDC20B in deuterosomal cells; SOX9 and ETV5 in tip cells; MUC16, SCGB1A1, SCGB3A1, SCGB3A2 in distinct secretory subsets.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates ciliated, deuterosomal, tip, and secretory lineage markers.

EVID_09.view_scope: CELL Fig.2 caption/text image; NE and secretory/airway marker panels

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: The broad fibroblast cluster comprises fibroblasts, myofibroblasts, airway and vascular smooth muscle (ASM and vSMC), pericytes, mesothelium, and chondrocytes (Figures 4A and 4B). Airway fibroblasts and chondrocytes were proximally enriched and mesothelium distally enriched... Isolated PDGFRA+CD141+ myofibroblasts express high levels of ACTA2, NOTUM, and LEF1. Whereas PDGFRA-CD141- fibroblasts express high levels of WNT2 and FGFR4.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 4B dot plot displays distinct expression signatures for mesenchymal subsets: ASPN, COL2A1 in chondrocytes; ACTA2, TAGLN in ASM; PLN, NTN4 in vSMC; WNT2 in alveolar fibroblasts; WNT2B, FGF10 in airway fibroblasts.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Primary validation for mesenchymal subsets (myofibroblast, ASM, vSMC, pericyte, chondrocyte, adventitial/alveolar/airway fibroblasts).

EVID_10.view_scope: CELL Fig.4 caption/text image; mesenchymal/vSMC/myofibroblast marker panels

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: ASCL1 and NEUROD1 regulate the formation of two subtypes of neuroendocrine cells. Classical pulmonary NE cells (GRP+) and GHRL+ NE cells (TTR+, GHRL+)... NEUROD1 was co-expressed with GHRL but also observed with GRP, whereas NEUROG3 was co-expressed with ASCL1 and/or NEUROD1, supporting a role in a transition population.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure 7A-E clearly delineates the bifurcated trajectory of NE cells: ASCL1/GRP in classical PNEC vs NEUROD1/GHRL/TTR/RFX6 in GHRL+ NE, with NEUROG3 marking intermediate progenitors.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Core evidence resolving PNEC vs GHRL+ NE vs intermediate NE cell granularity and TF markers.

EVID_11.view_scope: CELL Fig.7 caption/text image; GRP+ and GHRL+ pulmonary NE, ASCL1/NEUROD1/NEUROG3/RFX6

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: At 5–6 pcw, the endothelial cells (ECs) comprised capillary (early Cap: THY1+, CD24+), GRIA2+ arterial (GRIA2+, GJA5+), and lymphatic ECs (PROX1+, STAB1+, and UCP2LO)... Aerocytes express CA4 and S100A3... PLN is expressed in ASM but absent from vSMC.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S7B dot plot shows endothelial marker breakdown (CA4, S100A3, EDNRB in aerocytes; GJA5, EFNB2 in arterial EC; ACKR3, NR2F2 in venous EC; PROX1, STAB1 in lymphatic EC). Figure S7F-H shows vSMC (NDUFA4L2+, PLN-) vs adventitial fibroblast (NTRK3+, NDUFA4L2-).
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Validates endothelial specialization subsets and vSMC/fibroblast distinction.

EVID_12.view_scope: CELL Fig.S7 caption/text image; aerocyte/endothelial/vascular SMC/fibroblast markers

existing_round1_entry.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
existing_round1_entry.verbatim_quote: (C) Expression of NEUROD1, GHRL, and GRP in PNEC vs GHRL+ NE cells. (D) Co-expression analysis of NEUROG3 with ASCL1 and NEUROD1. (E) HCR staining for RFX6 in GHRL+ NE cells.
existing_round1_entry.visual_observation: Figure S8C-E shows mutually exclusive or enriched expression patterns confirming GHRL and NEUROD1 are positive in GHRL+ NE and negative in classic PNEC, whereas GRP is positive in classic PNEC and negative in GHRL+ NE.
existing_round1_entry.relevance: Supports polarity and specificity of NE subtype transcription factors and peptide hormones.

EVID_13.view_scope: CELL Fig.S8 caption/text image; NE trajectory and GRP/NEUROD1/GHRL/RFX6 labels
